title: Maximum Ascending Subarray Sum
summary: Given an array of positive integers, find the highest sum of a strictly increasing subarray.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, find the highest sum of a strictly increasing subarray. A subarray consists of consecutive elements from the original array.
constraints: Return the largest sum of a contiguous strictly increasing subarray.
hints: Split the array wherever strict increase fails.
Maintain the sum of the current increasing run and the best sum seen.
Extend on nums[i]>nums[i-1]; otherwise restart at nums[i].
Every increasing subarray lies within one maximal increasing run, and positivity makes the whole maximal run its best-sum member.
editorial: Every increasing subarray lies within one maximal increasing run, and positivity makes the whole maximal run its best-sum member.

tests.explanation: The final run [5,10,50] has sum sixty-five, larger than the first run.
The entire array is strictly increasing and sums to one hundred fifty.
